title: Spicetify Marketplace custom-app listing manifest
description: External crawler contract. The Spicetify Marketplace reads this file from the repository root on the default branch (repo must carry the 'spicetify-extensions' GitHub topic). Distinct from the spicetify-creator install manifest (dist/manifest.json).

name.description: App name shown on the card.

description.description: Card description. For this release, notes the spotify-dedup port lineage.

preview.description: Repo-root-relative path to a preview image, or an http(s) URL.

main.description: Repo-root-relative path to the built entry JS, or an http(s) URL. Relative paths must end in .js.

readme.description: Repo-root-relative path to the README, or an http(s) URL.

tags.description: Optional tags shown on the card.

authors.description: Optional author attribution. Defaults to repo owner if omitted.

branch.description: Optional publish branch. Omitted -> crawler uses the repo default branch (main).
